items.title: The KPEX Ecosystem: From First-Generation Estimating to a Connected Cost Intelligence Network

This transformation is redefining how cost estimates are produced, improving accuracy, accelerating decisions and enabling data-driven competitive advantage, while exposing the limits of fragmented, traditional approaches.
